direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px; FactoryStage >=55vw x >=60vh at 1366x768 on all steps, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned

colorTokens.stoppedRed: #E5484D only for stopped/offline CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; preserved owner exception
colorTokens.logo: immutable supplied black/emerald/silver asset, once in header, native aspect, never recolor/crop/redraw/duplicate

direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction + one status sentence, no slogans on working surfaces
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection/panel; single 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops/pulses/glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and uses pattern+marker+text

components.Header: 48px, logo left, state centre-right, Lock recovery room as button
components.StepRail: All 9 steps from one steps array, 36-40px icon+text+colour buttons, completed/current/locked, aria-current=step; remove dead Workspaces disclosure
components.GuideStrip: 52px, Step X of 9, instruction + status only, no duplicate primary
components.FactoryStage: Focusable cinematic SVG, synced inspector selection, every node keyboard-reachable, 2px #A8F04A focus outline offset 2px
components.EvidenceInspector: 360px, task-only content, required action pinned, blocked prior tasks visible as collapsed group until replacement approval
components.DecisionBar: 56px, Back left, human decision/status centre, one primary right; invalidating actions separated and text-labelled
components.Keyboard: Skip-to-stage first; header>rail>guide>SVG nodes>inspector>DecisionBar; arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

visualizations.FactorySVG: Inline SVG 960x540 cinematic side-elevation: dock/held lot, QA gate, conveyor, brushed-silver CELL-MILL-1/2, JOB-1001/1002 bays; silver idle, neon feasible/accepted only, red only stopped CELL-MILL-2, no route through offline cell
visualizations.StateBinding: Bind nodes/routes/badges/counts/inspector to real state: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible paths, online/offline, acceptance state, events, sealed packet; pending proposal deliberately untracked until approval; blocked prior tasks coexist with approved revised plan; selecting an option opens typed consent
visualizations.Evidence: Aligned Certificate 120 vs Receiving 80 quantity tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap; SVG-inspector bidirectional highlight
